examples.chinese: 我很喜歡做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zuòfàn.
examples.english: I like cooking very much.

examples.chinese: 我家的廚房很大，我常常在家做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de chúfáng hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng zài jiā zuòfàn.
examples.english: My kitchen is quite big, I often cook at home.

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

items.wordHook: 做(make) + 飯(meal) → make a meal, so 做飯 means "to cook."

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 我們學校旁邊有一家電影院。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.english: There is a movie theater next to our school.

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢 ？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 我最近沒有時間看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn méiyǒu shíjiān kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I don't have time to watch movies recently.

examples.chinese: 我同學送了我一張電影票，可是我沒有空去看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué sòng le wǒ yì zhāng diànyǐng piào, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu kòng qù kàn.
examples.english: My classmate gave me a movie ticket, but I don't have time to go see it.

examples.chinese: 我今天本來想去看電影，後來下雨就沒去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān běnlái xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, hòulái xià yǔ jiù méi qù le.
examples.english: Today I originally wanted to go see a movie, but later it rained so I didn't go.

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.
examples.english: These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 李導演付出了十年的時間，終於拍出了一部好電影，得到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn fùchū le shí nián de shíjiān, zhōngyú pāichū le yī bù hǎo diànyǐng, dédào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Director Li devoted ten years of time and finally made a good movie, receiving everyone's recognition.

examples.chinese: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shì yǐ àiqíng de tícái xiě chéng de, hòulái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làngmàn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This novel is written with a love theme, and was later made into a romantic movie.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.
examples.english: When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 對上班族來說，上網買牙刷、內衣褲、面紙等日用品，既輕鬆又方便。
examples.pinyin: Duì shàngbānzú lái shuō, shàngwǎng mǎi yáshuā, nèiyīkù, miànzhǐ děng rìyòngpǐn, jì qīngsōng yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: For office workers, buying daily commodities such as toothbrushes, underwear, and tissues online is both relaxing and convenient.

examples.chinese: 我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
examples.pinyin: Ā Wēn duì huācǎo hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùlùn shēngzhǎng zài píngyuán huò shāndì de, tā dōu jiàodechū míngzi lái.
examples.english: A-Wen is very interested in flowers and plants; no matter whether they grow on plains or in mountains, he can name them all.

items.key: ["B4L08-1-55","哪裡哪裡","哪裡哪裡/哪裡","哪里哪里/哪里","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does.

examples.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
examples.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

examples.chinese: 他不在教室裡上課，那他在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè, nà tā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: He is not in the classroom having class, so where is he?

examples.chinese: 我的錢包在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Where is my wallet?

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 開會時他遲到了，只好悄悄地坐在會議室後面。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí tā chídào le, zhǐhǎo qiāoqiāo de zuò zài huìyìshì hòumiàn.
examples.english: He was late for the meeting, so he had no choice but to quietly sit at the back of the conference room.

examples.chinese: 孩子：我玩電腦遊戲玩得正高興，你為什麼不讓我繼續玩？爸爸：得了！你玩到眼睛都紅了。去外面運動運動。
examples.pinyin: Háizi: Wǒ wán diànnǎo yóuxì wán de zhèng gāoxìng, nǐ wèishénme bù ràng wǒ jìxù wán? Bàba: Dé le! Nǐ wán dào yǎnjing dōu hóng le. Qù wàimiàn yùndòng yùndòng.
examples.english: Child: I'm having a great time playing computer games, why won't you let me keep playing? Dad: That's enough! You've played until your eyes are all red. Go outside and get some exercise.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

examples.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
examples.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ dì-yī cì cānjiā diàoyú bǐsài jiù dé le dì-yī míng, zhēn shì xìngyùn.
examples.english: Little Li got first place the first time he participated in a fishing competition; he is really lucky.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，差不多五度，冷得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, chàbuduō wǔ dù, lěng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low, about five degrees, and it was extremely cold.

examples.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 張經理不但常加班，還要做市場研究，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ bùdàn cháng jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, měitiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Manager Zhang not only often works overtime but also has to do market research; every day he is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 山本良介很厲害，早上剛學的五十個生字全部都記得了！
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hěn lìhài, zǎoshang gāng xué de wǔshí ge shēngzì quánbù dōu jìde le!
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is really impressive; he remembers all fifty new characters he just learned this morning!

examples.chinese: 黃小姐生日那天，男朋友送給她九百九十九朵玫瑰花，讓她感動得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě shēngrì nà tiān, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā jiǔbǎi jiǔshí jiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, ràng tā gǎndòng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: On Miss Huang's birthday, her boyfriend gave her 999 roses, which moved her incredibly.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 那個照相機貴得不得了，我買不起。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zhàoxiàngjī guì de bùdéliǎo, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: That camera is extremely expensive; I can't afford to buy it.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夏天熱得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān rè de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: Taiwan's summers are incredibly hot!

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
examples.pinyin: Bādé zài Huáyǔ nénglì cèyàn zhōng dé le bāshíliù fēn, hái ná dào le Huáyǔ gāojí zhèngshū, ràng tā kāixīn le bàntiān.
examples.english: Bade scored 86 on the Chinese proficiency test and also obtained an advanced Chinese certificate, which made her happy for a long time.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
examples.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
examples.pinyin: Bādé zài Huáyǔ nénglì cèyàn zhōng dé le bāshíliù fēn, hái ná dào le Huáyǔ gāojí zhèngshū, ràng tā kāixīn le bàntiān.
examples.english: Bade scored 86 on the Chinese proficiency test and also obtained an advanced Chinese certificate, which made her happy for a long time.

items.wordHook: a ⺊(divination crack) marks the spot 一(one) step up → 上(above).
Combining 保(safeguard) and 留(keep): 保留 means keep, to preserve.
The 酋(chieftain) bows a full 寸(inch) lower to show 尊(honor).
Combining 早(early) and 日(sun): 早日 means sooner.
an 雈(owl) perches on a 臼(mortar) grinding grain → 舊(old).
Spoken dispatches of important 言(speech) spread swiftly like birds that 卂(fly rapidly) to deliver 訊(news).
